comment: Program IDs this toolkit may WRITE to. Anything not listed is refused before a handle opens. Copy the entries you want into config/titles.local.json (gitignored) so your own console's ids never land in version control. The names map is safe to keep: title ids are global, and demos/trials need it because titledb has a null id for them.
